name: exo-deleted-recoverable-items-assessment
title: Exchange Online Deleted & Recoverable Items Assessment
shortDescription: This script assesses Deleted Items and Recoverable Items storage across Exchange Online user mailboxes and exports the highest-consuming mailboxes to CSV.
longDescription: Connects to Exchange Online with certificate-based app-only authentication, measures Deleted Items and Recoverable Items storage and item counts for user mailboxes, ranks mailboxes by combined storage, and writes a timestamped CSV report and execution log.
